title: Run End-to-End Legal Work with Harvey Agents
format_note: Five-chapter walkthrough of one legal task, plan to review, on a light ground with a dark intro card and dark closing statement; no voice.
one_thing: Agents handle the work end to end while the lawyer keeps the judgment, shown as one due-diligence request moving through five chapters.

transcript.voice_style: No speech. Local whisper returned only the repeated word 'The'; the only caption track is Belarusian-tagged ('be'), not English.
transcript.script_shape: All copy is on screen: Introducing line, a 01-05 chapter index, five 'Agents that ...' chapter titles, a two-line closing statement, then a wordmark.

structure.frame0: Pure white with the serif wordmark 'Harvey' centred and small (f0001.jpg); first two frames blank, wordmark from 0.1s (strips/window-01-0.033s.jpg).
structure.first_3s: Wordmark becomes 'Harvey Agents' by 1.9s, then a prompt box types 'Hey, Harvey - Help me prepare a red flag report for Project Alpha's diligence review' from 2.3s (window-03).

beats.what: Prompt box types the red-flag report request; cursor clicks send at about 5s.
Dark card: 'Introducing Agents that work end-to-end'.
Chapter index builds: 01 Plan to 05 Review.
'Agents that plan': audience question with cursor pick, then a five-step Agent Plan checklist.
'Agents that research': working log with case law and file sources.
'Agents that work async': task table with status pills moving to Ready for review.
'Agents that deliver': five files generated, cursor opens the Q4 Board Presentation slide.
'Agents that work with you': redlined memo, Harvey edit card, cursor clicks Accept.
Dark: 'Delegate the Work.' then 'Delegate the Work. Own the Judgment.'

hero_moment.what: Cursor clicks Accept on the Harvey edit card over the redlined memo, the point where the human takes the judgment (f0028.jpg).

ending.what: Two-line statement lands at about 60s, then wordmark holds on dark from 62s to the end; audio silence only the last 1.3s.

good.observation: One continuous task, a red-flag diligence report, carries all five chapters; each title is a verb the viewer just watched happen.
The 01-05 chapter index previews the structure before chapters begin, so a long static-looking body reads as progress.
Real-looking product screens with specific content (case names, file names, redline with percentages) read as credible legal work.
Titles stay one line, 3-5 words, 6.9% of frame height, in the same position beat after beat, so the eye always knows where to look.
The ending states the thesis in two short sentences, then holds the wordmark 5.3s on dark, matching the opening ground flip.
A real cursor clicks send, a file row and Accept, so each beat has a visible cause, including the hard cut at 5.17s.

weak.observation: Much UI text is small for a phone: task rows about 14px (1.9% of height), research log about 9px, with no zoom to compensate.
The film is static 60.6% of sampled intervals and the longest shot is 40.4s; there is no burst or peak, so energy stays flat.
Cards bleed off the right edge, cutting off column text such as 'Merger agr' and 'Indemnifica'.
Frame 0 is a small lone wordmark on white, with two blank frames first.

rule_candidates.rule: Titles of 6.9% height on one line, at most 5 words, fit the band; a serif closing statement can reach 9.6%.
A frame-0 wordmark alone on white was used here, with the product prompt typing from 2.3s; the subject should be in frame by 1s instead.
Flip the ground for brand bookends: dark intro (5.17-7.77s) and dark close (57.7-67.3s) around a white product body; each flip is a hard cut after a click.
Scale UI so row text is at least 2.6% of frame height (19px at 720); this film's 14px task rows read as texture, not facts.
Master music-only social films near -14 LUFS with true peak under -1 dBTP: this film sits at -13.9 LUFS and -2.2 dBTP.
